recalled_knowledge.item: (hbar c)^2 = 0.3894e-27 GeV^2 cm^2 for converting GeV^-2 to cm^2
Wilks/Cowan asymptotics: one-sided discovery statistic q0, Z = sqrt(q0)
chi^2 quantiles: 1.0 and 2.706 (1 dof, 68.3% and 90%), 2.30 and 4.61 (2 dof)
profile-ratio (Feldman-Cousins-like) 90% interval for one observed event with negligible background is mu in [0.105, 3.65]
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Feldman & Cousins PRD 57 (1998) 3873; reproduced numerically here (0.097-0.105, 3.64-3.65)

recalled_knowledge.item: at the kinematic ceiling delta = mu v^2/2 the allowed recoil window collapses to E* = delta mu/m_N
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: derived from v_min(E_R, delta) = (m_N E_R/mu + delta)/sqrt(2 m_N E_R)

recalled_knowledge.item: Okabe-Ito colour set is colour-vision-deficiency safe (figure cosmetics only)

failed_or_abandoned: First exact single-event p-value summed background density where d(E) >= f_248 without requiring q0(E) > 0 (gave a finite p at the ceiling where q0_obs = 0) and ran only for S_M ~ 0; replaced by the q0(E)-ordering formula with p = 1 when q0_obs = 0, applied for S_L < 1e-3 S_tot (delta >= 335 keV)
Gaussian low-energy variant initially dropped the 125-200 keV Poisson term (Z = 3.22 instead of 2.68 at delta = 300 keV); corrected so that only the Fig. 5 bins are replaced by the penalty
delta at which 248 keV is the observed median was interpolated on a non-monotonic array (returned 395 keV); fixed by sorting (380.8 keV)
Higgsino-line crossing interpolation included kappa_hat = 0 at the ceiling (log 0); restricted to the rising branch up to the Z peak
2 keV true-energy grid rejected (x1.5 kernel time for < 1% change in smeared densities); 3 keV used
A 2D {S1c, log S2c} likelihood was not attempted (no public LZ PDFs); the 1D observed-energy model with P016's anchor is the proxy
